mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in Real GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 40% of tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, a 0.5pp decrease in UNRATE and a 1% increase in PAYEMS signal a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window with joint labor market signals.

mechanism_narrative: A 5% monthly increase in INDPRO signals a surge in industrial production, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of non-recessionary periods with 5%+ INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, it signals increased retail sales, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward accuracy of RSAFS-based signals remains below 55% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 10bp decrease in FEDFUNDS, combined with a 1% increase in CPIAUCSL, signals a monetary policy-driven inflation boost, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 50% of instances with joint monetary-inflation signals.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in PAYEMS, without a corresponding decrease in UNRATE, signals a labor market mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window with labor market mismatch signals.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 3-month moving average, it signals increased housing market activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of low UNRATE (< 5%).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of low-unemployment periods with HOUST > 3-month MA.
